items.why: No headline names AMD directly, but the chip stock sell-off is accelerating and dragging chip names lower.
The fear gauge is climbing as stocks fall and the Nasdaq slumps on the chip sell-off.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Nvidia keeps sliding and is dragging the Nasdaq lower, with headlines calling the stock's slide a crisis for the market.

market_note: Futures are lower, with Nasdaq futures down 1.74% and S&P futures down 0.79%.
summary: Stocks are lower at midday, with the Nasdaq leading the slide as chip stocks sell off and Nvidia keeps falling. Even so, the major averages are still up for the week.
